verdict.rationale: Claude Code has its own programmatic surfaces. The Agent SDK exposes Claude Code's tools and capabilities with control over orchestration, tool access and permissions, and `claude mcp serve` lets other applications drive it. It can also be run non-interactively in CI and pipelines. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that every UI capability is reachable through these interfaces. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity mapping, programmatic access to UI-only surfaces (web/desktop sessions, scheduling, Remote Control), an API reference, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: the Agent SDK lets you build your own agents powered by Claude Code's tools and capabilities, with full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions.
You can use Claude Code itself as an MCP server that other applications can connect to
Claude Code is composable and follows the Unix philosophy. Pipe logs into it, run it in CI, or chain it with other tools
